scope.summary: Run the decouple-proof validation suite per Section 13.27 (the BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID matrix, REQ-001/002 proven at scale): every archetype x every channel group proves zero cross-region coupling — per-channel deltas confined to declared masks, no hidden runtime links outside the explicit graph, results machine-readable and wired into the descriptor.
acceptance_criteria: The matrix iterates all 8 archetypes x all channel groups: for each channel, apply a delta and assert resulting vertex deltas are confined to the channel's declared region mask within tolerance (zero cross-region deltas).
A hidden-link scan asserts no runtime value propagation exists outside the explicit MT-496 link graph (registry-vs-runtime parity at the channel-evaluation level).
The named regression: dialing breast volume on ARCH-A leaves every shoulder, hip, thigh, and midriff vertex bit-identical — the operator's founding complaint, executable.

Matrix results persist machine-readable (per-cell rows keyed by recipe + channel + mask hash) and feed BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID; any red cell fails the descriptor with the offending channel and region named.
The full matrix completes inside the CI long-lane budget; a smoke subset runs on every commit.
scope.risk_if_missed: Decoupling regresses silently as channels accumulate — one careless mask edit reintroduces exactly the breast-drags-hips coupling BodyKit was founded to eliminate, and nothing catches it.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Run the accepted source assets, anatomy, genital, creator-tool, DCC, visual, and performance corpora with pinned metrics and exact artifact inspection.
